acceptanceCriteria: Retained live runs (or recorded unavailable observations) for Playwright 1.64.0 on profiles /1 and /2, on Node 24, with system Chrome, and on Linux
Each newly qualified tuple is admitted only by its own PWP-V0 requirement and live evidence
body: Residual from V1-2005 / PR #1269 (#1263): Playwright 1.64.0 is qualified only for /0 and /3 on Darwin arm64 Node v22.23.2 with bundled browsers. Unqualified: /1, /2, Node 24, system Chrome, Linux. The consuming repository's checkout was not observed.
title: Qualify Playwright 1.64.0 external provider on /1, /2, Node 24, system Chrome and Linux
